crossRefs.note: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.
The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”
The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?
translations.bsb: Then some of the people of Jerusalem began to say, “Isn’t this the man they are trying to kill?
translations.kjv: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?
translations.asv: Some therefore of them of Jerusalem said, Is not this he whom they seek to kill?
